title: IdleMesh overview

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Every enrolled node with its hardware profile (S3.3) and inference backends (S3.4).

panels.title: Idle share by hour of the week
panels.description: Share of idle samples (no input for idle_after_s, or locked) by local day and hour, across all nodes, over the dashboard's time range. Empty cells had no samples.

panels.title: Node states
panels.description: Each node's state from its idle samples (S2.5). Gaps are sleep or no data.

panels.title: CPU use
panels.description: Whole-machine CPU use per node (S3.5).

panels.title: GPU use
panels.description: Mean NVIDIA GPU use per node. Nodes without an NVIDIA GPU report none.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: System RAM in use per node.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Hottest CPU or GPU sensor the OS exposes; absent where it exposes none.

panels.title: Model cache disk free
panels.description: Free space on the disk holding each node's model cache.

panels.title: Tunnel errors (since agent start)
panels.description: Counters count from the agent's start; a drop means the agent restarted (see agent uptime), never a silent reset.

panels.title: Errors by code
panels.description: Warnings and errors per error code (contracts/error-codes.json) from all nodes and the coordinator, in 5-minute buckets.

panels.title: Errors by code and source
panels.description: Totals over the dashboard's time range. Look a code up in docs/error-codes.md.

panels.title: Contribution level
panels.description: The contribution governor's level per node (S4.9, D-12): it ramps up with idle time, is capped by time windows and owner settings, and drops to the yield level within about a second of user input.

panels.title: Crash reports
panels.description: Agent panics and worker crashes (S4.3), newest first. The full report (backtrace, last worker output, redacted config) is at /api/v1/groups/{group}/devices/{device}/crash-reports/{crash_id}.

panels.title: Network map
panels.description: Nodes coloured by cluster (D-22, D-24; clusters never span subnets), each joined to the coordinator by its own link (RTT, and bandwidth once tested, S5.2), and to other nodes by links that join a cluster. Compare it with the building layout (Sprint 5 demo).

panels.title: Nodes and links
panels.description: Each node's subnet and cluster, its RTT to the coordinator from heartbeats (S5.1) and its link bandwidth from the latest tunnel test (S5.2). An empty Link cell means never tested: placement then leaves that link's traffic out (S5.3).

panels.title: Link bandwidth to the coordinator
panels.description: Tunnel bandwidth tests (S5.2): the slower of the two directions. Weekly in off-hours, and at once on a node's first worker start or a network change.

panels.title: RTT to the coordinator
panels.description: Heartbeat RTT, recorded only when it changes or once a day (S5.1, D-25), so points are sparse on a steady network and step at a change.

panels.title: Probe health
panels.description: Failed and refused bandwidth tests, degraded links and tunnel faults, by error code (docs/error-codes.md). LINK_DEGRADED: bandwidth below half the last test, or RTT up by more than probes.rtt_change_pct.

panels.title: Fleet: predicted vs. actual staying idle (60 min)
panels.description: Every accuracy run (predictor.accuracy_every_h) scores the last 24 hours against a fit made without them. Predicted: the mean chance the model gave each idle minute of staying idle for the next hour. Actual: how often it did. The lines should stay together.

panels.title: Drift by node: predicted minus actual
panels.description: Above 0: the model was too hopeful about that node; below 0: too gloomy. A node whose line moves away from 0 and stays there has changed its routine (S6.4).

panels.title: Brier score by node
panels.description: Mean squared error of the predictions (0 is perfect, 0.25 is a coin toss). Compare with the evaluation notebook, experiments/analysis/predictor-evaluation.ipynb (S6.2).
